summary.text: David Gregory is a Republican member of the Missouri Senate for District 15 in St. Louis County, first elected in 2024, and took the oath of office on January 8, 2025.
His official Senate page lists him as vice-chair of the Insurance and Banking and the Judiciary and Civil and Criminal Jurisprudence committees.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography describes Gregory as a litigation attorney who was elected to the Missouri House of Representatives in 2016 and in 2021 chaired the House Special Committee on Government Accountability.
It says he is a St. Louis native with an accounting degree, an MBA, and a Juris Doctor from Saint Louis University, and that he lives in St. Louis with his wife, Paige.
